description: Parse one Content-Security-Policy and report its structure, with the fallback rules applied. A fetch directive absent while default-src is present is reported as covered; base-uri and frame-ancestors do not fall back, so absence there is a finding. unsafe-inline alongside a nonce is reported differently from unsafe-inline alone, since supporting browsers ignore it. A repeated directive is reported because only the first takes effect. Structure only, not an assessment of adequacy. Pay 160000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

policy.description: The header value, without the header name. Nothing is fetched.
policy.example: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' data:; style-src 'self'; connect-src *; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; frame-ancestors 'none' https://partner.test; report-uri /csp

report_only.description: Whether this was served as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only. A report-only policy blocks nothing, which is recorded so the findings are read correctly.

require_directives.description: Directives that must be covered. Defaults to default-src, script-src, object-src, base-uri and frame-ancestors.

name: csp_structural_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

directives.description: Per directive: source count, the sources, and whether each of the wildcard, unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval, strict-dynamic, nonce, hash and none markers is present.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

structurally_strict.description: True only when every required directive was covered and nothing in the policy widened it in the ways reported. Not a judgement that the policy is adequate.

title: CSP Structural Audit
